name: Gambia National Data Centre (Abuko)
developer: Government of The Gambia (GICTA/MOCDE) via PPP with Margins ID Group
notes: Inaugurated by President Barrow together with NIMS launch on 2026-07-01 at Abuko, Western division (Greater Banjul Area). GICTA DG Prof Abdou Karim Jallow; Margins ID Group CEO Moses Baiden described the facility as ISO-certified sovereign digital infrastructure. Grade B for facility existence/inauguration until an official GICTA/MOCDE/State House page opens; ISO-certified claim stays B/C without certificate evidence. Capacity (MW/racks) and power details unknown.

name: GAMTEL Co-location / Kairaba Exchange (Serekunda)
notes: GAMTEL officially sells co-location/facility rental (site rent, tower space, rack space, site+space) for servers/telecom hardware at any of its 43 sites or towers countrywide - A-grade service claim but must NOT be multiplied into 43 datacenters. Kairaba Exchange at Kairaba Avenue, Serekunda (Western) is the named GAMTEL exchange/colo facility per PeeringDB and directory leads (C/B); no operator site-level, PURA or NAWEC record yet confirms it as a DC. GAMTEL HQ is at 3 Nelson Mandela Street, Banjul (premises lead only). SIXP/Serekunda Internet Exchange (PeeringDB ix/2682) is network presence nearby, not a DC.

name: WARDIP/DTFA (P176932) data centre & landing-station works
developer: Government of The Gambia (MOCDE/GICTA/GAMTEL) with World Bank IDA funding
notes: WARDIP SOP-1 (USD 50M IDA) covers second submarine cable, a new landing station (anchored near Banjul/GBA), and construction/upgrading of GAMTEL facilities and data centers across the country (ESMF wording). A-grade for program scope; per-site facilities are NOT countable without tender/permit/power/operator evidence. Division attributed to Banjul for the landing-station anchor; overall scope is national incl. Western/GBA.
No confirmed datacenter activity in Lower River (Mansakonko/Soma). Only GAMTEL internet-cafe/telco presence; WARDIP NBN upgrades possible but no site-level evidence.
No confirmed datacenter activity in Central River (Janjanbureh/Kuntaur). No government ICT, telco exchange or power evidence naming a facility.
No confirmed datacenter activity in North Bank (Kerewan/Farafenni). No named facility evidence found.
No confirmed datacenter activity in Upper River (Basse Santa Su). No named facility evidence found.
